request_notes: Temporary registry passwords issue credentials and remain confirmed and non-retryable. POST list/detail/validation APIs are retrievals.
Current v2 statusCode 800, v1 statusCode 0 and historical code 0 envelopes are separate contracts, not interchangeable success aliases.
Chart definition, values and README contents are JSON-envelope strings, not binary download responses.

notes: Image scan-status responses only publish the example Success without a terminal enum or failure states; no example-only waiter is inferred.
VPC access responses are nested collections queried by a list of VPC IDs; no scalar exact identity selector is available.
Cleanup schedules and retention execution/task collections cannot filter one execution identity through a declared scalar input; the first or latest row is not selected.
Synchronization-rule state is documented but omitted from the captured detail example, preventing verified waiter fixture coverage. Historical namespace detail does not require a namespace identity.
